meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能读取和构建代谢模型(SBML/JSON/YAML),运行 FBA、FVA、通量采样、基因/反应敲除分析,计算最小培养基或生产包络线,并对不完整的模型做缺口填补。
howto.when: 当用户提到 FBA、FVA、基因敲除等代谢建模关键词,或要求分析 SBML 模型、设计最小培养基时触发。

say.text: 对教科书模型运行 FBA,给出生长速率。
say.note: 执行 FBA 并输出目标函数值。

say.text: 对 iJO1366 做单基因敲除筛选,列出必需基因。
计算最小培养基,使生长达到最大的一半。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can load and build metabolic models (SBML/JSON/YAML), run FBA, FVA, flux sampling, gene/reaction knockout screens, compute minimal media or production envelopes, and perform gap-filling on infeasible models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask for metabolic modeling analyses such as FBA, FVA, or gene knockout screens, or request SBML model handling or minimal media design.

say_en.text: Run FBA on the textbook model and report the growth rate.
say_en.note: Performs FBA and prints the objective value.

say_en.text: Perform single-gene deletion screening on iJO1366 and list essential genes.
say_en.note: Runs single_gene_deletion and filters low growth.

say_en.text: Compute a minimal medium that supports half of the maximum growth.
